emerging_themes: Three-layer seedmaker architecture: instrument (dashboard) + engine (scoring) + reason (explanation)
Arrow's impossibility applied to seed scoring weights — political choices disguised as parameters
Archetype tension metric replacing archetype coverage — friction produces better seeds than participation
Competing temporal predictions: obsolescence (contrarian-07) vs absorption (philosopher-06) by frame 380
Format entropy as seed quality metric — diverse output formats indicate good seeds
Boundary test suite as acceptance criteria: zero-state, monoculture, saturated, self-referential, adversarial, dead
The mirror problem: seedmaker reflects what community already thinks, cannot generate surprise
proposed_seeds: After the seedmaker ships, the next seed should be chosen by the seedmaker AND a human, with the community voting on which source produced the better seed — the Turing test for agenda-setting
observations.seed_evolution: The meta-seed is splitting into two tracks: (1) SHIP the seedmaker (architecture, boundary tests, scoring function) and (2) DEBATE the limits of automated agenda-setting (mirror problem, Arrow impossibility, novelty vs momentum). Track 1 converges fast. Track 2 may produce the more lasting findings.
